# OmniTune continuation instructions

Read `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, `docs/DEVELOPMENT.md` and `docs/PROJECT_PROGRESS.md`.
The code and current progress document are the source of truth; do not rely on historical release reports.

Use the existing feature-first architecture, Riverpod generation, secure storage and i18n.
Preserve WebDAV/OpenList redirects, cache behavior, source profiles and player sessions.
All UI implementation must be delegated to Antigravity with taste skill in the single **OmniTune** conversation recorded in project progress. Resume by explicit conversation ID.
All test implementation and changes, including UI regressions, performance checks and ADB scripts, must be delegated to OpenCode free models. Verify zero pricing; never automatically fall back to paid models. Codex reviews and runs checks.

Run the relevant tests, static analysis and `./scripts/build_apk.sh` after completing code changes.
See AGENTS.md for localization, generation, platform and playback requirements.
